name: Greece
title: Greece — Halkidiki and a 2008 journey
description: Travel films from Gerakini and Mount Itamos in Halkidiki, a summer camp at Agios Nikolaos, and a 2008 trip to Skopelos, Mount Olympus, Pella, Meteora, and Thessaloniki.
lede: Halkidiki, and a 2008 trip across Greece.
hero_alt: A pine-covered shore and turquoise water at Agios Nikolaos, Halkidiki, from the summer camp film.
map_aria: Map of filmed places in Greece
index_blurb: Halkidiki, and a 2008 trip to Skopelos, Mount Olympus, Pella, Meteora, and Thessaloniki
intro: These films follow places in Greece named in the titles and descriptions: Gerakini and Mount Itamos in Halkidiki, a summer camp at Agios Nikolaos, and a 2008 trip with Tres to Skopelos, Mount Olympus, Pella, Meteora, and Thessaloniki.
They come from more than one visit. The map marks the places that can be located from the films; it is not a record of one continuous drive.

states.name: Halkidiki
states.note: Gerakini is named as his favorite beach in Greece, and the place where he grew up. The summer camp film is set in Agios Nikolaos, Halkidiki, where he spent childhood summers. The Mount Itamos hike is listed in the order of that film’s chapters.

states.name: A 2008 trip with Tres
states.kicker: Skopelos, Mount Olympus, Pella, Meteora, and Thessaloniki
states.note: These are the places named in the 2008 film, listed as they appear there. The film also names Halkidiki, which is covered in the section above.

stops.name: Gerakini
stops.note: His favorite beach in Greece, and the place where he grew up. The film looks at clear Aegean water, schools of fish, rocky outcrops, and soft sand.
stops.chapter_text: The film Swimming in Gerakini, Greece | Crystal Clear Water & Marine Life is described as his favorite beach in all of Greece and the place where he grew up, with a chapter titled “Life under the sea.”

chapter_sources.excerpt: Swimming in Gerakini, Greece | Crystal Clear Water & Marine Life
This is my favorite beach in all of Greece — and the place where I grew up. Located in Gerakini, Halkidiki… I take you below the surface to see what life looks like underwater.
00:20 Life under the sea

stops.photo_alt: YouTube thumbnail for Swimming in Gerakini, Greece | Crystal Clear Water & Marine Life, used for Gerakini

stops.name: Summer camp at Agios Nikolaos
stops.note: A tribute to the ΧΑΝΘ camp where he spent childhood summers — beaches, paths, and friendships. The pin marks the village named in the film; the exact camp grounds are not given.
stops.chapter_text: The film ΧΑΝΘ Κατασκήνωση Αγίου Νικολάου | My Summer Camp Tribute in Halkidiki is described as a tribute to the place where he spent childhood summers, with beaches, paths, and memories, at Agios Nikolaos, Halkidiki.

chapter_sources.excerpt: ΧΑΝΘ Κατασκήνωση Αγίου Νικολάου | My Summer Camp Tribute in Halkidiki

My tribute to one of the most beautiful places I’ve ever lived. This is where I spent my childhood summers — filled with beaches, laughter, games, and unforgettable memories. Location: Agios Nikolaos, Halkidiki

stops.photo_alt: YouTube thumbnail for ΧΑΝΘ Κατασκήνωση Αγίου Νικολάου | My Summer Camp Tribute in Halkidiki, used for Summer camp at Agios Nikolaos

stops.name: Mount Itamos
stops.note: The mountain of the hike, with forest paths and views toward the Aegean.
stops.chapter_text: The film Mount Itamos, Greece | Hiking to an Ancient Tree describes a hike on Mount Itamos (Dragoudeli) in Sithonia, Halkidiki, to the ancient Itamos tree. The short A Greek Mountain Overlooking the Aegean shows a view from Mount Itamos toward the Aegean Sea.

chapter_sources.excerpt: Mount Itamos, Greece | Hiking to an Ancient Tree — “Explore Mount Itamos (Dragoudeli) in Sithonia, Halkidiki, Greece, on a hike to the ancient Itamos tree.”
A Greek Mountain Overlooking the Aegean #Shorts — “A view from Mount Itamos, where the mountain landscape opens toward the Aegean Sea.”

stops.photo_alt: YouTube thumbnail for Mount Itamos, Greece | Hiking to an Ancient Tree, used for Mount Itamos

stops.name: Profítis Ilias Church
stops.note: The first stop on the Mount Itamos hike. A short was also filmed at the church on Mount Dragoudeli, which the long film treats as the same mountain.
stops.chapter_text: The Mount Itamos film has a chapter titled Profítis Ilias Church. The short Mount Dragoudeli, Greece | Profítis Ilias Church describes a stop at Profítis Ilias Church on Mount Dragoudeli in Halkidiki.

stops.name: Pyrofylakio / Fire Tower
stops.note: The second chapter of the Mount Itamos hike. A precise point for the tower is not given, so it is not marked separately; the map pin for the mountain is nearby.
stops.chapter_text: The Mount Itamos film has a chapter titled Pyrofylakio / Fire Tower, and its description includes the fire tower on the route.
